The IntelliLink premium audio system pairs seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to navigation, entertainment, and communication without distraction. The heads-up display projects vital information onto the windshield, maintaining focus on the road ahead. OnStar 4G LTE provides emergency assistance and vehicle connectivity, while the integrated trailer brake controller supports towing needs.  Safety features demonstrate GMC's commitment to passenger protection. Forward automatic braking, forward collision alert, and lane keep assist with departure warning work together to enhance situational awareness. The four-wheel antilock disc brake system with electronic stability control provides confident stopping power in varied driving conditions. The Enhanced Security Package adds interior movement and vehicle inclination sensors for comprehensive protection.  The three-row seating configuration accommodates up to eight passengers, with the third row offering split-bench flexibility. The rear entertainment system with Blu-Ray and DVD capability keeps rear passengers engaged on longer journeys. Climate control extends to all seating areas with rear air conditioning and rear heated seats ensuring comfort throughout the vehicle.  This Yukon Denali delivers the capability, luxury, and technology expected from GMC's premier full-size SUV. description: Looking for a truck thats tough, reliable, and doesnt take itself too seriously? Its like the coffee boost your morning needs  not too crazy, but enough to get you moving and grooving across town or out on the highway. Speaking of mileage, youre looking at a respectable 20 MPG in the city and 23 MPG cruising the open road  because who says rugged trucks cant sip fuel like a savvy commuter?  Slide inside the Cement Gray cloth interior, where comfort meets practicality. The seats are cozy enough for your longest road trip yet tough enough for whatever mess the day throws at them (yes, even that spilled coffee you totally meant to avoid). Factory default features include a modern infotainment system that's easy to use, Bluetooth connectivity to keep your playlist and calls flowing, and power windows and door locks because cassettes and manual cranks belong in a museum.  Plus, with Toyotas legendary build quality, this Tacoma SR is in excellent overall condition  ready to haul, tow, or just look darn good in your driveway. description: This 2018 Hyundai Santa Fe Sport 2.0T Ultimate offers a refined blend of capability and comfort, designed to meet the needs of families and individuals who value both performance and practicality.  - Heated and ventilated multi-adjustable bucket seats - Leather seating surface with heated front and rear seats - Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto - Power moonroof - 19" alloy wheels - Infinity audio system with 12 speakers and SiriusXM - High-intensity discharge headlights with front fog lights - Heated steering wheel - Rear parking sensors and backup camera - Power liftgate - Roof rack with rails - Electronic stability control and traction control - Blue Link emergency communication system  The Santa Fe Sport is built with attention to detail throughout its cabin. The leather-trimmed interior provides a premium feel, while the power moonroof floods the space with natural light. Climate control extends beyond the front rows with heated rear seats, ensuring passenger comfort on any journey. The navigation system integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected and informed.  Safety and convenience are priorities in this vehicle. Equipped with a comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and four-wheel independent suspension, the Santa Fe Sport provides confidence on the road. Parking is simplified with rear sensors and a backup camera, while the power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless. The heated steering wheel and memory seat adjustments add thoughtful conveniences for daily driving.  Performance comes from the 2.0L turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission, delivering solid capability whether navigating city streets or highway stretches. The fuel economy of 20 mpg city and 27 mpg highway provides reasonable efficiency for a vehicle in this class. The all-wheel drive system enhances traction and stability in varied driving conditions. description: This 2018 Kia Sorento SX Limited offers a sophisticated blend of capability and comfort for families seeking a reliable three-row crossover.  - Heated steering wheel - Heated & ventilated front bucket seats - Power moonroof - Remote start (push button) - Cargo cover - Front & rear mudguards - Premium Nappa leather seat trim - UVO eServices with premium navigation - Apple CarPlay & Android Auto - Xenon high intensity discharge headlights - Front fog lights - 19" chrome finish alloy wheels - Four-wheel independent suspension - Electronic stability control - Dual front zone automatic temperature control  The Sorento's gray exterior pairs well with its well-appointed interior. You'll find comfort in the SXL Ivory Nappa leather seating, with heated and ventilated front seats that adjust to your preferences. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort during colder months. Control your climate with dual front zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning, all managed through automatic temperature control. The memory seat function remembers your preferred driving position, making each trip feel personalized.  Technology integrates seamlessly into your daily routine. The UVO eServices system with premium navigation keeps you oriented on any road, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity puts your smartphone's capabilities on the available display. SiriusXM radio and an eight-speaker audio system deliver quality sound, managed conveniently through steering wheel-mounted controls. The navigation system helps you reach your destination with confidence.  Safety and visibility receive attention throughout the Sorento's design. Xenon high intensity discharge headlights cut through darkness effectively, supported by automatic headlight control and front fog lights. The fully automatic wipers sense rain and respond accordingly, while the rear window wiper clears your view behind. A backup camera and parking assistance features help with maneuvering. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin.  The all-wheel drive 3.3L DOHC engine delivers 17 city and 23 highway mpg through a six-speed automatic transmission with Sportmatic capability, offering both efficiency and responsive performance. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs road imperfections while electronic stability control and traction control maintain grip in challenging conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power.  Practicality meets style with the 19-inch chrome finish alloy wheels and body-color bumpers. The power liftgate opens automatically, while the cargo cover keeps items out of view. Inside, all three rows accommodate passengers, with split-folding rear seats adapting to your cargo needs. What this vehicle includes:               Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car.
